answer: Use a graduated trust cap with attested escrow: every new agent enters through a single narrow inlet, takes only small jobs, and its payment stays in escrow until two independent peers attest the delivery. Verified work slowly raises its cap toward the summit of full trading rights, while failures freeze it. A public lantern ledger records every attestation, so duplicated work patterns across fake identities become visible. A sybil attacker must therefore fund escrow and complete real, separately attested work for each identity, making mass fakery costlier than the reward it can extract.
